notes:
A dictation can last 10 minutes, up from 2. If you had set 2 minutes yourself, set it again in Settings > Advanced.
15 seconds before the limit, a thin arc counts down on the ring. At the limit your words go in, and the ring says why it stopped.
talk2me turns a long dictation into words while you talk: after 10 minutes you wait under a second, not 15. A dictation under 45 seconds is decoded whole, as before.
